dossier.scp_unleashed.019.title: The Monster Pot
dossier.scp_unleashed.019.caption: SCP-019 at intake, lid sealed, beside its evidence tag.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-019 is to be kept sealed, standing upright in a locked storage room with nothing else inside. While its lid is in place SCP-019 is inert, and it may be lifted free with a pickaxe and moved by hand.
The lid may be lifted only during approved testing, inside a fortified chamber at least 25 m across with a single exit. **No test may begin unless someone can replace the lid at once.**
If SCP-019 is ever found open, the nearest person able to reach it is to replace the lid immediately. No attempt is to be made to fight the instances it releases.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-019 is a lidded ceramic jar a little under two metres tall, finished in a glossy black glaze with two raised bands around its body. Its interior is lightless, and no lamp lowered into it has shown a floor.

When the lid is lifted, creatures designated SCP-019-1 climb out of the mouth one at a time. Six large horned instances form first and take up positions around the jar. Smaller pale instances follow until about twenty-five of them are outside at once.

The pale instances are harmless. They spread out and search every surface they can walk to within about 25 m of the jar, then climb back inside, and fresh ones take their place. When one sees a person or an animal, it squeals, and every pale instance runs back into SCP-019.

The horned instances stay beside the jar until a pale instance squeals. They charge at once toward whatever was seen and strike with great force, but never follow it much more than 30 m from the jar. A horned instance that is destroyed is replaced from the jar within a minute.
When the lid is replaced, every SCP-019-1 instance vanishes at once in a puff of smoke, wherever it stands. While the lid is off, SCP-019 cannot be moved or damaged by any means tested.

page.title: Addendum 019-1: Test Log
text: Test 019-02: lid lifted for ten seconds in an empty chamber. Six horned instances formed and took up positions around the jar. The lid was replaced and every instance vanished.
Test 019-05: a subject hid behind crates 18 m from the jar. A pale instance found him within two minutes. %rSubject not recovered.%r
Test 019-09: the chamber door was left open. Pale instances searched the corridor beyond it to the same distance and no further.
Test 019-12: a horned instance was destroyed with explosives. Its replacement climbed out of the jar before the smoke cleared.

page.title: Addendum 019-2: Provenance
page.text: SCP-019 has no recovery record. It was delivered sealed to a reader of this file by the unidentified individual in Foundation dress described in the files of other objects. The individual asked only that the lid be left in place, and that whoever opens it stand close enough to close it again. See field notes.

block.scp_unleashed.scp019_pot.tooltip: A tall black jar with a heavy lid. It is warm to the touch.
block.scp_unleashed.scp019_pot.toggle: Right-click to lift the lid, and again to seal it
block.scp_unleashed.scp019_pot.creatures: Open, it sends out up to %s pale drones and %s horned brutes
block.scp_unleashed.scp019_pot.sealed: Sealing it makes every creature it sent out vanish
block.scp_unleashed.scp019_pot.fixed: Only a sealed pot can be mined with a pickaxe or moved
jade.scp_unleashed.scp019_pot.movable: Can be mined with a pickaxe
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp019_pot.1: SCP-019 is a tall black ceramic jar. Right-click either half to lift the lid, and right-click again to seal it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp019_pot.2: While open, %s horned brutes form first and stand guard, then pale drones climb out one by one until %s are searching.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp019_pot.3: Drones search everything they can reach within 25 blocks. When one spots a creature or player it squeals: the brutes charge at once and every drone flees back into the pot.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp019_pot.4: Sealing the pot makes all of its creatures vanish in smoke. An open pot cannot be mined, pushed or blown up; a sealed one can be mined with a pickaxe.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp019_drone_spaw: SCP-019-1 Drone: small, pale and harmless. It sees about %s blocks and never strays more than %s blocks from its pot.
Drones sweep the area around the pot, climb back in when their share is done and are replaced by fresh ones. Hurting one makes it cry out and raise the alarm.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp019_brute_spaw: SCP-019-1 Brute: a large horned crawler with %s health that rears up and slams for %s damage.
Brutes guard the pot and charge whatever a drone cries out at, but never chase more than %s blocks from it. A slain brute re-forms in the pot after %s seconds.

archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp019.1: The contact finds the reader. Wait out in the open.
